subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group per-sender isolation become an opt-in Feishu plugin capability, a narrower session-scoping enhancement, or be deferred to an external/plugin prototype until a missing core API is identified?
rationale: The requested behavior crosses channel routing, subagent lifecycle, memory isolation, skills/config ownership, and admin/security policy, so automation cannot choose the product boundary safely.

options.title: Design opt-in Feishu per-sender agents
options.body: Keep the issue open for a Feishu/plugin-owned design with lifecycle limits, quotas, memory namespaces, admin controls, and explicit security review before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to session-scoped isolation
options.body: Treat groupSessionScope and current-conversation bindings as the supported path, and split any missing session-routing gaps into smaller Feishu issues.

options.title: Defer to external plugin prototype
options.body: Ask a Feishu owner or community plugin to prototype the orchestration outside core unless the prototype identifies a missing plugin API.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in Feishu per-sender agents
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for a Feishu/plugin-owned design with lifecycle limits, quotas, memory namespaces, admin controls, and explicit security review before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The manifest identifies m1heng as the Feishu plugin community maintainer, making them the best available owner for the Feishu-specific product boundary choice.
